Westwood Holdings Group Inc who had been investing in Methode Electronics Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.48 billion market cap company. (NYSE:MEI) has declined 12.77% since May 4, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 24.32% the S&P500.
